note: Sample questions and changes for testing WhyBase. 'expect' is what a freshly seeded graph returns in offline mode; tests/test_examples.py checks every entry.

questions.q: Why do we use Kafka for the event bus?
questions.shows: The SUPERSEDES chain D-002 → D-001 with ADRs and deciders.

questions.q: Why did we use RabbitMQ?
questions.shows: RabbitMQ was replaced, so the answer is flagged out of date and points to the current decision.

questions.q: Why do we use KMS for secrets?
questions.shows: D-014 replaced the Vault decision D-013.

questions.q: Why did we use Vault?
questions.shows: The system is found from the word 'Vault' alone; Vault is superseded.

questions.q: Why does the mobile app use React Native?
questions.shows: D-020 replaced native apps (D-019) after the Android lead left.

questions.q: Why do we use OpenSearch?
questions.shows: D-010 replaced Elasticsearch.

questions.q: Why do we have an API gateway?
questions.shows: A system with two active decisions (D-016, D-017).

questions.q: Which docs are out of date?
questions.shows: 3 docs on a fresh seed, each with who should fix it. Departed authors are routed to teammates.

questions.q: Who knows payments-ledger?
questions.shows: The top expert has left; only one active person remains.

questions.q: Who knows mobile-app?
questions.shows: Zoya Khan (left) wrote the native ADR; two active engineers remain.

questions.q: Who knows secrets-vault?
questions.shows: Security team members ranked by evidence.

questions.q: Which systems are at risk?
questions.shows: payments-ledger, data-warehouse and notification-service each depend on one active person.

questions.q: Who knows checkout-api?
questions.shows: The system exists but no source mentions it: nothing connects.

questions.q: What breaks if we reverse D-002?
questions.shows: 7 items up to 3 hops, including Instant Refunds via D-005 → D-004.

questions.q: What breaks if we reverse D-007?
questions.shows: Session tokens hold up the API gateway, audit log, Enterprise SSO, SOC 2 and the Public API.

questions.q: What breaks if we reverse D-011?
questions.shows: Several paths reach Mobile Relaunch; each item is counted once.

questions.q: What breaks if we reverse D-013?
questions.shows: The old Vault decision: nothing relies on it any more.

questions.q: Which decisions are most load-bearing?
questions.shows: PageRank over RELIES_ON; D-002 ranks first.

questions.q: What did we use for search on 1 Jan 2026?
questions.shows: Elasticsearch then; it has since been replaced.

questions.q: What did we use for secrets on 1 Jan 2026?
questions.shows: Vault then; KMS now.

questions.q: What did we believe about mobile-app as of 2025-01-01?
questions.shows: Native Swift and Kotlin apps.

questions.q: What was the event bus on 2023-06-01?
questions.shows: Before any recorded decision.

questions.q: Who knows quantum-cache?
questions.shows: Not in the graph, so only the resolver runs. No traversal.

questions.q: Why do we use blockchain-ledger?
questions.shows: A made-up system name is never queried.

questions.q: What breaks if we reverse kafka?
questions.shows: 'kafka' matches several decisions, so WhyBase asks which one.

questions.q: Tell me a joke
questions.shows: Not a graph question; nothing runs.

changes.label: Event bus → Redpanda (demo)
changes.text: Team call today: we're moving event-bus from Kafka to Redpanda — Kafka ops cost is too high and Redpanda speaks the Kafka API. — Priya Nair

expect.author: Priya Nair
expect.summary: Move event-bus from Kafka to Redpanda

changes.label: Feature flags → LaunchDarkly
changes.text: Growth sync: moving feature-flags from in-house to LaunchDarkly — running our own flag service costs too much. — Sana Qureshi

expect.author: Sana Qureshi
expect.summary: Move feature-flags from in-house to LaunchDarkly

changes.label: Auth → passkeys
changes.text: Security review: moving auth-service from Redis to WebAuthn passkeys so sign-in survives device changes. — Kavya Rao

expect.summary: Move auth-service from Redis to WebAuthn

expect.author: Kavya Rao
expect.summary: Switch api-gateway from per-key to per-account
